slides.title: Text: a film review
body: Pixar's *Coco* follows Miguel, a 12-year-old boy who dreams of becoming a musician, even though his family has banned music for generations. On Day of the Dead, he accidentally enters the Land of the Dead.

The animation is breathtaking: the colorful bridges of marigold petals and the glowing city are unforgettable. However, the real strength of the film is its emotional story about memory and family. Some viewers may find the plot predictable, but the ending is genuinely moving. A must-see for all ages.

items.q: What is the main problem for Miguel?
options: He is lost in a city.
